newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changan dives 9.65 pct early afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Changan dives 9.65 pct early afternoon.

text.p: Foreign currency B shares in Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd plunged HK$0.44 or 9.65 percent to HK$4.12 in early afternoon trading on Wednesday after the firm announced weak 1996 results, brokers said.
Volume hit 421,700 shares within half an hour of the opening of the afternoon trading session.
"Changan fell because of its poor results," an analyst with Shenzhen J & A Securities said. "But the share is unlikely to fall further as it looks quite cheap after the sharp fall."
Changan on Wednesday posted net 1996 profit of 202.83 million yuan compared with 220.16 million for 1995 based on international accounting standards.
The company proposed a cash dividend of 0.03025 yuan per B share based on 1996 profits, pending an annual general meeting of shareholders on June 16, the firm's 1996 annual report said.
Trading in Changan's B shares were suspended on Wednesday morning, pending the company's announcement of its 1996 results, and resumed in the afternoon. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
